changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Entity') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[Entity]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [EndpointVersionID] [int] NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Api_Entity] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Entity_AssetType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[Entity] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Entity_AssetType] FOREIGN KEY([AssetTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AssetType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [api].[Entity] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Entity_AssetType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Entity_EndpointVersion') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[Entity] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Entity_EndpointVersion] FOREIGN KEY([EndpointVersionID]) REFERENCES [api].[EndpointVersion] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [api].[Entity] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Entity_EndpointVersion] END

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: if not exists (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Entity]') AND name = N'IX_Api_Entity_AssetTypeID') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Api_Entity_AssetTypeID] ON [api].[Entity] ( [AssetTypeID] ASC ) end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Entity]') AND name = N'IX_Api_Entity_AssetTypeID') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Api_Entity_AssetTypeID] ON [api].[Entity] END
